name: animejs
title: Anime.js v4
responsibility: Lightweight, ergonomic animation engine — timers/animations/timelines, Draggable, ScrollObserver, SVG drawing/morphing, text splitting, stagger utilities. The middle ground: more reach than Motion Primitives, less ceremony than GSAP.

moduleMap.animejs: everything (animate, createTimeline, createTimer, createDraggable, createScope, onScroll, stagger, utils, svg, text)
moduleMap.animejs/animation: animate() — targets, tween values, keyframes, function-based params
moduleMap.animejs/timeline: createTimeline() — sequenced animations, labels, position params, defaults
moduleMap.animejs/draggable: createDraggable() — axes/snap/modifier, release spring physics, callbacks
moduleMap.animejs/layout: Layout transitions — record/animate/update with enterFrom/leaveTo/swapAt, layout ids
moduleMap.animejs/scope: createScope() — root-scoped animations, React-safe revert, media queries
moduleMap.animejs/events: onScroll() ScrollObserver — thresholds, sync modes, enter/leave/update callbacks
moduleMap.animejs/utils: stagger(), $, set, random, snap, clamp, wrap, mapRange, lerp, damp, shuffle…
moduleMap.animejs/easings: spring, cubic-bezier, steps, irregular, linear + built-in eases
moduleMap.animejs/engine: engine params — timeUnit, speed, fps, precision, pauseOnDocumentHidden
moduleMap.animejs/adapters: Three.js adapter — object properties, transforms, materials/uniforms

reachFor: Staggered entrances and text reveals with minimal code (animate + stagger)
SVG path drawing/morphing and motion paths
Draggable with spring release physics (no plugin matrix like GSAP)
When GSAP feels too heavy but Motion Primitives doesn't reach far enough
avoid: Scrubbed long-form scroll storytelling with pinning — GSAP ScrollTrigger is the deeper tool
Simple in-view entrances — Motion Primitives stays first (principle: simple stays simple)
Physics-based React state transitions — React Spring fits better

recipes.label: createScope React wiring: root-scoped, reduced-motion-aware, revert-safe

inRepo: no consumers yet — canonical wiring provided; first-class npm peer installed at root
